harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: The preposition phrase «بعذاب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «سأل», and «سأل» includes the meaning of the verb «دعا» (to call for).

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: «للكافرين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) {سَأَلَ} in the sense of «دعا», i.e.: a caller called down upon the disbelievers a punishment bound to fall.

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: The preposition phrase «من الله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) {دَافِعٌ}; «ذي» is a naʿt (adjective) of the Divine Name.

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: The clause «تعرج الملائكة» is resumptive; the two preposition phrases «إليه» and «في يوم» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تعرج»; the clause «كان» is a naʿt (adjective) of «يوم»; «ألف» is tamyīz (specification), and «سنة» is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: The clause «إنهم يرونه» is resumptive, and «بعيدا» is a second object.

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The adverb «يوم» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) {قَرِيبًا}.

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: The clause «ولا يسأل» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {تَكُونُ}.

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: The clause «يُبَصَّرونهم» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «يودّ»; «لو» is maṣdariyya (infinitival), and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «يومئذ»: «يوم» is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and «إذٍ» is an adverbial noun, a muḍāf ilayhi.

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: «من» is a relative noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «فصيلته»; «جميعا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in the implied (muqaddar) ṣila (relative clause); the clause «ينجيه» is conjoined to the clause {يَفْتَدِي}.

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The clause «كلا إنها لظى» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t:
«نزاعة» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in {لَظَى}, because, although it is a proper name, it is treated like derived words, since it has the meaning of blazing (التلظِّي).

«للشوى» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «نزاعة», and the lām is redundant (zāʾida), for strengthening.

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: The clause «تدعو» is a second khabar (predicate) of «إن» in verse «15».

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: (إن الإنسان خلق هلوعا) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive; «هلوعا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: «إذا» is a pure adverb in both places; {جَزُوعًا} and «منوعا» are two ḥāls (circumstantials) from the pronoun in {هَلُوعًا}, the implied form being: anxious, being impatient at the time evil touches him, and «منوعا» [withholding] at the time good touches him.

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: «المصلِّين» is excepted from {الإِنْسَانَ} in verse (19), which denotes the genus.

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: «الذين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «المصلين»; the preposition phrase «على صلاتهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «دائمون».

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: The ṣila (relative clause) is the nominal clause «حق معلوم في أموالهم».

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: The preposition phrase «للسائل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a second naʿt (adjective) of {حَقٌّ}.

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: The preposition phrase «من عذاب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مشفقون».

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: (إن عذاب ربهم غير مأمون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is parenthetical.

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: His words «والذين»: a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the relative noun in verse (27); «لفروجهم» is the object of «حافظون», and the lām is redundant (zāʾida).

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: (إلا على أزواجهم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The excepted [noun] is omitted, i.e.: guarding them (حِفْظَها); the preposition phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (muqaddar) maṣdar (verbal noun) (حِفْظَها); and the clause «فإنهم غير ملومين» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; «هم» is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: The relative noun is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the relative noun in verse (29); the lām in «لأماناتهم» is redundant (zāʾida), and «أماناتهم» is the object of «راعون».

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: The preposition phrase «بشهاداتهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قائمون».

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: The preposition phrase «على صلاتهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يحافظون».

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: (أولئك في جنات مكرمون) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: (فمال الذين كفروا قبلك مهطعين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The fāʾ is resumptive; «ما» is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); «قِبَلك», the adverb, is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the relative noun; «مهطعين» is a second ḥāl.

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: (عن اليمين وعن الشمال عزين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The preposition phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) {مُهْطِعِينَ}; «عِزين» is another ḥāl (circumstantial) from the relative noun, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is assimilated to the sound masculine plural.

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يدخل» is accusative by removal of the preposition «في»; «جنة» is a second object.

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: The preposition phrase «ممَّا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خَلَقْناهم».

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: The clause «فلا أقسم» is resumptive, and the clause «إنَّا لقادرون» is the answer to the oath.

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: The genitive interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قادرون»; the preposition phrase «منهم» is attached to «خيرا»; the clause «وما نحن بمسبوقين» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {إِنَّا لَقَادِرُونَ}; the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in the khabar (predicate) of «ما» acting like ليس.

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: The clause «فذرهم» is resumptive; the clause «يخوضوا» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied (muqaddar) condition; «يومهم» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the relative noun is a naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: «يوم» is a badal (substitute) from {يَوْمَهُمُ}; «سراعا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «يخرجون», and the clause «كأنهم يوفضون» is a second ḥāl.

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: «خاشعة» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of {يُوفِضُونَ}; «أبصارهم» is the fāʿil of «خاشعة»; the clause «ترهقهم» is a second ḥāl from the fāʿil of {يُوفِضُونَ}; the clause «ذلك اليوم» is resumptive; «الذي» is a naʿt (adjective) of «اليوم».
